title: X resolved a three-year dispute with Australia's eSafety regulator after a court upheld a fine against the company for inadequate disclosures on combating CSAM (Byron Kaye/Reuters)
summary: Byron Kaye / Reuters: X resolved a three-year dispute with Australia's eSafety regulator after a court upheld a fine against the company for inadequate disclosures on combating CSAM — An Australian court upheld a regulator's fine against Elon Musk's social media company X Corp after it admitted violating the law …
